Players Committee card image of [[Zeb Orrelios]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. During battle with an opponent's combat vehicle (or with two Rebels), attrition against opponent is +2. Rebels here are immune to Trample.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/zeborrelios.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
